instruction: You are given a pipe template `/home/user/Desktop/pipe_base/`. Complete a turbulent-flow analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/pipe_turb/`: - Build a 3D circular-pipe geometry; near-wall mesh must satisfy turbulence near-wall requirements - Select a turbulence model and set inflow conditions and fluid properties - Run to convergence 2. Extract wall `y+` and outlet mass flow rate. 3. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Outlet mass flow rate `mass_flow` - Wall-averaged `y+` as `avg_yplus` - Format: `mass_flow, avg_yplus` 4. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
